concurrency.dispatch: Coordinator launches at most two specialists at a time; no child spawning.

sharedAcceptance: Read AGENTS.md, docs/agents/README.md and the relevant ownership brief before work.
Audit the actual consumer and API/provider path using tracked source first, named representative fixtures and narrow checks.
Each specialist writes its own report with revision, evidence, reproducible finding, impact, severity, test outcomes, unmeasured scope and next owner.
Keep local source, merged source, live deployment and installed-phone evidence separate.
No speculative bug claim, invented coverage or speed, broad data scan, full build, live refresh, catalogue write, deployment, commit or push.
Report files are exclusive. Runtime repair ownership is assigned separately by the coordinator; coordinate shared files sequentially.
Do not overwrite unrelated original-worktree changes or restart old reporting schedules.

assignments.scope: Own coding/integration audit: actual mobile-to-versioned-API boundaries, user activity writes and rendering, haptic preference, loading and pricing caller delivery, lean bounded work and unshipped runtime dependencies.
assignments.acceptance: Identify source-backed cross-component mismatches and release gaps with exact files/lines; run only the relevant targeted integration checks. Provide the specialist assignment plan.

assignments.scope: Backend metadata correctness and missing-field contracts, language/identity conflicts, response mappings and bounded read/error behavior, starting app/lib/versioned API/gateway paths. Coordinate local fixes with root's repair-agent ownership assignment.
assignments.acceptance: Reproduce at least one highest-impact metadata failure or document a bounded no-change finding. A local repair must preserve original language, card identity and provenance, have meaningful regression evidence, and remain distinguishable from an unapproved production data correction.

assignments.scope: Own fresh price audit: daily coverage/checkpoint semantics, old rare eligibility, provider identity, general/exact/sold labels, raw and graded UI callers, freshness and owner cache isolation. Use the latest rollout receipt as historical evidence rather than repeat it as a fresh measurement.
assignments.acceptance: Trace named vintage and modern common controls through current callers and service contracts; verify unresolved prices stay explicit and bulk guides never become exact/sold/holdings evidence. Run focused identity/label/freshness tests and name any remaining measured versus unmeasured coverage.

assignments.scope: Own loading audit: startup, search/set/Pokédex first useful content, visible image thumbnail versus large delivery, request fan-out/cancellation, partial results and bounded cache recovery. Device measurements are unavailable unless actually obtained.
assignments.acceptance: Trace at least startup plus one catalogue screen. Identify demonstrated serial waits, unbounded work, stale cache/blank loading or image-delivery blockers; state exact request bounds and run narrow loading/cache tests. Do not promise instant measured loading from static source.

assignments.scope: Own image audit: current API manifest-to-app image selection, native-language/edition/finish preservation, sharper original source evidence, corrupted/cropped image handling, approved replacement receipts and CoroCoro covers.
assignments.acceptance: Use named representative card/cover records and current source paths. Distinguish verified delivered originals from staged/downloaded material and missing licence or edition evidence. List exact next actions outside verified acquisition capabilities; no fresh acquisition or catalogue promotion in this audit.

assignments.scope: Own English/native-name audit: main's Chinese language-conflict guards, card/set display provenance, non-Pokémon Trainer identity, aliases and fallback titles, keeping native language intact.
assignments.acceptance: Trace the named zh-tw Marnie/Pikachu conflict and representative ja/zh-cn/zh-tw display contracts. Verify incompatible source references cannot supply English names or search aliases. Separate source-fixed/deployed/unresolved canonical data and provide a concrete outside-capabilities list.

assignments.scope: Own Pokédex audit: species/form identity, name aliases, Trainer/Energy exclusions, language filtering, four-page bounded continuation, ownership counts and cards detail links.
assignments.acceptance: Exercise actual route/service fixtures for Pikachu, encoded Mr. Mime and a form/gender control; confirm consumed-page cursor behavior and no ownership or language cross-contamination. State live versus fixture evidence and hand off metadata contamination to backend.

assignments.scope: Own search audit: app UI and progressive global query path, multilingual aliases, card/set/product/profile/listing filters and ranking, partial errors, cancel/race handling and cursor continuation.
assignments.acceptance: Verify named exact card, native/English alias and set queries with bounded fixtures, honest partial-result behavior and deterministic language/printing identities. Record presentation/accessibility gaps only with source/UI evidence and measured latency only if observed.

assignments.scope: Own independent read-only review of all new audit findings and backend local repair, identity/provenance/account/auth boundaries, bounded work and actual evidence claims. Run after other report files exist.
assignments.acceptance: Review current-task diff separately from pre-existing work; independently reproduce sensitive backend/price invariants, mark false positives or unsupported claims, and return blocking versus nonblocking findings with file/line references.

backgroundHandoff: Root owns the persistent repair-agent configuration and continuation queue. Reusable agent definitions and a report do not themselves run overnight; continuation must explicitly describe its actual execution mechanism and remaining live-operation approval boundaries.
